workspace.notFoundText: This package does not exist in the current demo data, or its project is no longer available.

header.submitNotReady: This package is not ready to be submitted yet.
header.blockedConflict: Resolve the working-draft conflict before submitting a formal version.
header.blockedStages: All stages must be completed before a formal version can be submitted.
header.blockedReport: The report stage result must be confirmed before the report can be submitted.
header.demoHint: Simulated browser execution only — no Codex call and no server write.
header.demoPauseReason: Available only while the simulated execution is running.
header.demoResumeReason: Available only while the simulated execution is paused.
header.demoRetryReason: Available only while a stage is failed.
header.demoFailureReason: Available only while the simulated execution is running.

notice.conflictTitle: Working draft conflict needs your decision
notice.conflictText: A stale run returned a candidate that conflicts with your manual edit.
notice.failedText: The execution failed. Confirmed results and fixed inputs were preserved.
notice.pausedText: The execution is paused. Resume to continue from the latest checkpoint.
notice.pendingSupplementText: The package is waiting for supplemental input before it can continue.

conflict.title: Working draft conflict
conflict.text: The running task produced a candidate from stale inputs while you were editing. Submitting a formal version is blocked until you choose a resolution; formal versions stay untouched.
conflict.outlineHint: Only section titles are listed here — open the artifact in the stage area to inspect the full content.
conflict.blockSubmitHint: Formal submission stays disabled until the conflict is resolved.
conflict.resolvedDone: Conflict resolved; the package can continue.

stage.noInputs: No material inputs recorded for this stage.
stage.inputUnavailable: This material version is not accessible in the current demo data and cannot be treated as verified evidence.
stage.runningTitle: Simulated execution is generating the stage result…
stage.notStartedText: The simulated execution starts this stage automatically after the previous stage is confirmed.
stage.awaitingText: A stage result is waiting for your confirmation before the run continues.
stage.completedNoArtifact: Stage completed without a structured result
stage.completedNoArtifactText: This stage has no separate artifact to confirm. Its outcome is recorded in the execution history.
stage.failedUnknown: The simulated execution failed before producing a stage result.
stage.saveDone: Saved as a new artifact revision.
stage.confirmDone: Stage result confirmed; the run may continue.
stage.readOnlyHint: Delivered versions are read-only. Use continue editing to create a new working draft before artifacts can be changed.
stage.supersededHint: This revision has been superseded and is kept for history only.
stage.needsReviewText: Review this result before continuing; confirmation is intentionally not offered for this state.
stage.confirmText: The confirmation record is linked to the exact input versions listed below. Confirmed results can still be viewed later but are never modified in place.
stage.readyToSubmitText: No formal version exists for this package yet. Submit the current results as the first formal version.
stage.noStagesText: This package has no stage blueprint in the current demo data.

artifact.unsupported: This artifact kind is read-only in the generate workbench.

draft.partialHint: This draft is explicitly marked as partial.
draft.workingDraftNoBase: Brand new work, not based on any formal version.
draft.workingDraftHint: The working draft never rewrites a formal version. A new formal version is only created when you submit.

panel.title: Package context
panel.conversationEmptyText: Messages explain stage decisions; they never replace stage results.
panel.artifactsEmptyText: Stage results appear here once the simulated execution produces a candidate.
panel.versionsEmptyText: Submitting a formal version freezes inputs, stage results and the deliverable.

submit.freezeText: A formal version is an immutable snapshot of inputs, stage results and the deliverable. Later edits create a new working draft.
submit.demoHint: The deliverable is assembled from the simulated stage results in this browser.
submit.unfinishedPlaceholder: Which scope is intentionally left unfinished?
submit.unfinishedHint: Filling this field submits the version as a partial delivery.
submit.inputsHint: Unavailable inputs are marked. They do not block submission, but they cannot be claimed as verified.
submit.stageResultsHint: Only the latest revision of each stage is frozen into the version.
submit.previewUnavailableText: The current package has no draft document to preview.
submit.previewHint: The delivered file is assembled from the frozen stage results when the version is submitted.
submit.reportMissingText: The report stage result does not exist yet; submission records the current scope only.
submit.coverageLine: Coverage: {{checked}} checked · {{unchecked}} not checked · {{uncheckable}} cannot check · {{na}} n/a
submit.findingLine: Findings: {{high}} high · {{medium}} medium · {{low}} low · {{info}} info · {{uncertain}} uncertain
submit.differenceLine: Differences: {{added}} added · {{removed}} removed · {{modified}} modified · {{moved}} moved · {{uncertain}} unconfirmed
submit.reportFooter: This is a simulated frontend report; the report body keeps its own demo disclaimer.
submit.failed: Submission failed; the form stays open.
submit.newVersionText: The page has been refreshed with the frozen version. The new version is highlighted in the version list.

continueEdit.text: Choose the exact formal version the new working draft is based on.
continueEdit.hint: The selected formal version stays read-only. Only the new working draft can be edited.
continueEdit.noVersions: No formal version to continue from
continueEdit.noVersionsText: Finish and submit a formal version first.
continueEdit.failed: Could not create the working draft.
continueEdit.done: Working draft created from the selected version.

wizard.noProjectsText: A task must live inside a project. Create a project first, then start a task.
wizard.invalidKindText: The requested task kind is not supported by this wizard.

errors.baseVersionRequired: An exact base version is required.
errors.reportVersionRequired: A delivered report version is required.
errors.sameVersion: Baseline and target must be different versions.
errors.sourceReviewMissing: The source review package is not accessible.
errors.sourceCompareMissing: The source comparison package is not accessible.

source.title: Source task
source.subtitle: Read-only source of this revision
source.baseVersionHint: Only this exact version is authorized for modification; all other versions stay read-only.
source.permission: I confirm this revision is authorized only for the base version and the selected scope above.

generate.pageDescription: At minimum: choose a project and describe the delivery goal. Revision mode also needs the exact base version and the authorized modification scope.
generate.autoText: A package is created and the simulated execution starts producing stage results. Candidates never enter a formal version without your confirmation.
generate.noVersionsHint: This project has no formal version yet, so only new-material mode is available.
generate.titlePlaceholder: Name this task inside the project
generate.goalHint: Describe what must be delivered and what the reader should do with it.
generate.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Produce a technical scheme for phase one of the park that can pass internal review.
generate.requirementsHint: Optional. Each line becomes a requirement the work must cover.
generate.basePlaceholder: Select the formal version to revise
generate.scopeHint: Only scope inside this authorization can be changed; everything else stays for reference only.
generate.scopePlaceholder: e.g. Only sections 3.2, 5 and 6 may be modified.
generate.materialsSubtitle: Materials are exact-version inputs; unreadable files are marked.
generate.materialsHint: Optional. Unreadable materials can be selected but never counted as verified evidence.
generate.unreadableTitle: Some selected materials are not fully readable
generate.unreadableText: Failed or partially parsed materials cannot be treated as verified evidence. They may still be referenced as task context.

review.pageDescription: At minimum: choose the exact object under review, state the review purpose and describe the scope.
review.autoText: A review package is created and the simulated execution builds a coverage plan and findings. The report only becomes a formal version after your confirmation.
review.goalHint: What question must the review answer?
review.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Check whether the scheme meets the requirements document.
review.targetSubtitle: Only an exact formal version or material version can be reviewed.
review.noVersionsHint: This project has no formal package version yet.
review.noMaterialsHint: This project has no readable material version yet.
review.unreadableText: Materials whose parsing failed cannot be the review target: {{names}}
review.basisSubtitle: Requirements, standards and materials the review is judged against.
review.basisHint: Basis materials are recorded as exact versions with the task; unreadable ones can only be listed as context.
review.requirementsHint: Optional. Each line becomes a rule the review must apply.
review.scopeHint: State what is inside and what is explicitly outside this review.
review.scopePlaceholder: e.g. Only the body text of the scheme; attachments are out of scope.

compare.pageDescription: At minimum: choose two different formal versions of the same project and describe the comparison scope.
compare.noticeTitle: A change is not automatically a defect
compare.noticeText: The comparison describes what changed between two exact versions. It never concludes that the change is wrong.
compare.notEnoughText: The comparison needs two different formal versions inside the same project.
compare.scopeHint: State which parts are compared and which are out of scope.
compare.scopePlaceholder: e.g. Compare the full body of V1.0 and V1.1; annexes are out of scope.
